# Loaner

Temporary compute operated by your local coding agent.

- [Agent workflow](AGENTS.md): planning, authorization, jobs, readiness, recovery, and cleanup.
- [Quick start](README.md): available capabilities and current provider limits.

Run `loaner capabilities` for machine-readable provider/profile availability and `loaner --help` for commands. Unavailable profiles are rejected before payment. Use a saved plan and aggregate budget; do not silently downgrade machine requirements.
